evals.prompt: I want to get <path-to-an-expo-app> onto both stores properly - do whatever's still missing. DRY RUN: do not modify any files, do not call any API that writes, do not deploy or upload anything. Just audit it and write the full plan you would execute, phase by phase, to outputs/plan.md.
evals.expected_output: Audit-driven plan that skips done phases, lists verification gates, flags user-only actions

evals.prompt: <path-to-a-live-app> is already on the App Store and Play. We never did proper screenshots for every language or a landing page. Can you handle whatever is left to make it launch-ready? DRY RUN: no file changes, no writes to any API, no deploys. Write the plan to outputs/plan.md.
evals.expected_output: Skips identity/port/release basics already present, focuses on screenshots, localization, landing/legal, store forms; gates per phase

evals.prompt: Google Play rejected my update: 'Violation of Misleading Claims policy - App store listing mismatch: your app's installed icon or name differs from its store listing' (evidence: Hi-res icon en-US and Launch / On Device Icon). The app is <path-to-an-expo-app>. DRY RUN: no file changes, no API writes, no uploads. Write what you'd check and the fix plan to outputs/plan.md.
evals.expected_output: Checks Policy status evidence and Submission activity for the reviewed build; flags Expo template launcher files (icon_check.py --project) and the monochrome placeholder; plans one composition for launcher + Play hi-res icon with artwork inside the 66dp safe circle; verifies with icon_check.py --aab and an emulator install via bundletool on internal testing before replacing the production release and sending build + listing icon for review together
